title: Jellies and Pickles
wikitext:
{{for|a detailed analysis of profit using the Preserves Jar|Preserves Jar Productivity}}
'''Jellies''' and '''Pickles''' can be produced by inserting either a [[Fruits|fruit]] or a [[Vegetables|vegetable]] / [[Foraging#Foraged Items|foraged item]] in a [[Preserves Jar|preserves jar]], respectively. The value of a single jar of jelly or pickles is equal to (2 * Base [[Crops|Crop]] Value + 50). Jelly and pickles are unaffected by the quality of the fruit or vegetable used.

A [[Preserves Jar|preserves jar]] requires 4000 minutes, or 2-3 days, to produce jelly or pickles.<ref name="timing details" />

==Products==
Quality of ingredients makes no difference to the finished product. The value of the finished product is determined using the base value (''i.e.,'' with no silver or gold star) of the [[Fruits|fruit]]/[[Vegetables|vegetable]].

'''Notes'''
* Pickles made from an inedible vegetable will instead give [[File:Energy.png|24px|link=]] 0.625 × Base [[Vegetables|Vegetable]] Price and [[File:Health.png|24px|link=]] 0.28125 × Base [[Vegetables|Vegetable]] Price.<ref name="pickle energy" />
* Jelly made from an inedible fruit will instead give [[File:Energy.png|24px|link=]] 0.5 × Base [[Fruits|Fruit]] Price and [[File:Health.png|24px|link=]] 0.225 × Base [[Fruits|Fruit]] Price.<ref name="jelly energy" />
* The following foraged items can be pickled: [[Cave Carrot]], [[Chanterelle]], [[Common Mushroom]], [[Dandelion]], [[Ginger]], [[Hazelnut]], [[Leek]], [[Magma Cap]], [[Morel]], [[Purple Mushroom]], [[Snow Yam]], [[Spring Onion]], [[Wild Horseradish]], and [[Winter Root]].
* The color of Jelly or Pickles changes depending on the item used to make it.

==Bundles==
Jelly is one of the options for the {{Bundle|Artisan||y}}.

==Tailoring==
Jelly is used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create a [[Tailoring|Shirt]]. [[File:Shirt092.png|24px]]

Pickles are used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create a [[Tailoring|Shirt]]. [[File:Shirt091.png|24px]]

Jelly can also be used as a red dye color at the dye pots in [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, located at [[2 Willow Lane]], and Pickles can be used as a green dye.

==Quests==
*One Jelly (of any type) or one Pickles (of any type) may be requested by [[Catfish]], [[Rainbow Trout]], [[Spook Fish]], [[Super Cucumber]], or [[Sturgeon]] in [[Fish Pond#Quests|Fish Pond quests]].
*One Jelly is requested by the Raccoon at the [[Giant Stump]] as part of his second request. It may also be requested as part of any request starting with the sixth.
*One Pickles is requested by the Raccoon at the [[Giant Stump]] as part of his fourth request. It may also be requested as part of any request starting with the sixth.

==Trivia==
*Jelly sold by the [[Traveling Cart]] will not be of any fruit type and will sell for {{Price|160}} ({{Price|224}} with the [[Skills#Farming|Artisan Profession]]).
*Pickles sold by the [[Traveling Cart]] will not be of any vegetable type and will sell for {{Price|100}} ({{Price|140}} with the [[Skills#Farming|Artisan Profession]]).
*The description of the [[Preserves Jar]] states that it makes Jam, but it actually produces Jelly.

{{History|1.6|Jellies and Pickles now change color depending on the item used to make them. Jellies and Pickles are now consumable. Positive energy foraged items can now be made into Pickles. Both Jelly and Pickles are now requested by the Raccoon.}}
